latestVersion.changelog:
django-unfold 1.0.0

Optimize the development of your admin interfaces with this unofficial skill designed specifically for Django-Unfold (v0.56+). This tool acts as a technical copilot for implementing Unfold's modern design, following best practices and avoiding common configuration mistakes.

What this skill includes:

Critical Configuration Guide: Master the INSTALLED_APPS order and correct class inheritance (ModelAdmin, StackedInline, TabularInline).

Comprehensive UX/UI Reference: Advanced widget implementation, custom templates, and the unique use of the @display decorator.

Segmented Documentation: Quick access to guides on theming, dashboards, filters, tabs, and third-party integrations.

Bug Fixes: Curated list of common pitfalls related to Tailwind CSS and custom navigation.

Note: This is an independent support tool and is not affiliated with, associated with, or endorsed by the official maintainers of Django-Unfold.
